quest.title: To Colorfall Cliffs!
quest.description: Bennett told you about a scenic spot called "Foamflower Fields" at Colorfall Cliffs...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3, Easybreeze Badge x1

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Here we are! So these must be the Foamflower Fields marked on the map.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How come it's all so... green?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks more like the Foamgrass Fields to me.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Haha, it's not exactly what I imagined, either... But, that happens a lot!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: You mean false advertising? Yeah, when it's as bad as this, I usually file a complaint.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Otherwise, my tour groups would file a complaint about me!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: No, no. Sorry, I should've been more specific.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I mean more like... when reality doesn't live up to your expectations. That happens to me a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, because of...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Yeah. It's things like... climbing to the top of a mountain to see the view, only for a thick fog to roll in, you can barely see two feet in front of you.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Or gathering a bunch of firewood, only to find that a Pyro Slime snuck into your tent and set it all on fire...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Oh, man. That's rough...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Eh, I've gotten used to it by now. What adventure doesn't have a few bumps in the road?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: So, when you think about it, being able to enjoy this vast, open scenery, fresh air all around and no monsters in sight... I'd call that some pretty remarkable luck!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: What's even more remarkable is your ability to stay positive.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh, hey. I think the Asha found something. Pretty sure that's what that sound means.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Geez, you can understand each other already? You two must be on the same wavelength or something!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: (You finish reading through.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow. The archiest of arch-enemies...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: If they were both people, maybe they could sit down and talk it out, but... But one's an Asha.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: C'mon, let's lend a hand! You ready, Asha?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, wait a second. How did we skip straight to action mode? Paimon doesn't even know what the game plan is.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: If you think about what the Asha love doing most, it must be dyeing things different colors, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah... And?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: And they're simple, pure-hearted beings.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: So, I doubt that Asha is here to cause trouble on purpose. The little guy probably just can't stand how dull and uninspiring all this plain grass looks.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Yeah, and it's not like he could communicate any of that...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Right! So if we help dye the meadow in a range of vibrant colors... Y'know, turn it into an actual flower field...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: ...We can make that Asha happy and help out the staff member at the same time!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Took the words right out of my mouth!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Huh, a little conflict mediation... I like the way you think. You've got peacemaker potential.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm in.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Haha, stop... that tickles...! Oh, are we going somewhere? Is it far? I should let my friends know first—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, where are you—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, interpreter — did you catch any of that?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Maybe something needs to be moved? Or there's someone else nearby who needs our help even more...?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Okay, those two things sound completely unrelated! What are you even basing that off of?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Well, the longer I watch Asha, the more their body language reminds me of saurians.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Huh... You better not be lying to me.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: No, I'm serious. In saurian body language, the same movement can often mean unrelated things. When my saurian mom raised her wings, it either meant "come home early for dinner" or "you're in big trouble, kid."

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Wait, then how did you tell the difference?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: When I was little, I couldn't. Lemme tell you, I walked straight into a lot of punishments...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Wow, super sturdy, and fast too... So this is a Natlanese hot air balloon? It's awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Up here, everyone! Look! We're back!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Whoa, it looks incredible! The Foamflower Fields finally live up to their name!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great work, everyone! Now we've just gotta let that staff member know, right?

dialogues.speaker: Tikraq
dialogues.text: Please, everyone, wait up... *panting*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Talk about perfect timing!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: It's okay. Catch your breath first...

dialogues.speaker: Tikraq
dialogues.text: *huff*... Phew, alright. I'm the staff member in charge of the main event here at Colorfall Cliffs — the Airborne Asha challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Tikraq
dialogues.text: Just now, gazing down from above, I saw the meadow suddenly transform into a sea of flowers. And the colors were so stunning... I almost dropped my binoculars!

dialogues.speaker: Tikraq
dialogues.text: Y—You truly are the saviors of Colorfall Cliffs!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It was nothing, hehe. Besides, these two did most of the work!

dialogues.speaker: Tikraq
dialogues.text: Kind-hearted adventurers, would the pair of you consider taking part in our challenge?

dialogues.speaker: Tikraq
dialogues.text: Or rather... Would you do us the honor of bringing some color to our landmarks too?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: That sounds awesome... But are you sure we're allowed to do that?

dialogues.speaker: Tikraq
dialogues.text: Of course, of course! I would love nothing more!

dialogues.speaker: Tikraq
dialogues.text: You did my colleague such a huge favor, so it's only right that I thank you on his behalf. And I figured an experience like this would be even more special than a monetary reward!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh, no. We want the—

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: What she means is, we'd be delighted to help you out! Haha... So, how do we get there?

dialogues.speaker: Tikraq
dialogues.text: Please, follow me. We'll take the hot air balloon up.

talks.objective: Ride the hot air balloon and head to the "Airborne Asha"

dialogues.speaker: Tikraq
dialogues.text: Alright, we're here. This, ladies and gentlemen, is the Airborne Asha.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Whoa, it's so cool! I didn't expect it to be this big...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Once it's painted, I bet we'll be able to see it from miles off.

dialogues.speaker: Tikraq
dialogues.text: Oh, for sure! As long as you're in an open area and the view isn't blocked by mountains, you'll be able to see it from anywhere — whether that's the rooftop pool on Huha Hill or the fjords on Tete Isle.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: That's awesome! Your work's gonna be center stage — you've got this!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Man, I'm getting excited already! Should I go with my lucky color? Or maybe...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, he sure had a lot to say this time, huh.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you catch any of that, Chasca? Mind translating for us again?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Hmm, that was a lot to take in. It'll take me some time to sort out all the different possibilities...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #It's okay, I think I got the gist! The Asha wants to team up with me and compete against {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: He likes helping people out by working together with friends.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: But, it's the element of competition that turns ordinary activities into exciting adventures, and that's what he enjoys the most.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He really said all that!?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Haha, more or less! I filled in the gaps here and there.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: From his reaction, it looks like you got it spot on. The bond between you guys really is growing stronger...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #Alright, Asha. I like that idea, but we should make sure {NICKNAME} thinks it sounds fun too, right?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: It's always important to check in with your friends and respect their opinions!

choices.text: A chance to challenge our team captain — just what I've been waiting for.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: "Then let the games begin."

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Haha... Sorry, with you looking at me like that, I just can't say that with a straight face.

response.speaker: Tikraq
response.text: Alright, well if both teams are ready, then follow me! I'll be the referee.

choices.text: As long as you two are happy, that's all that matters.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: #Hey, we can't be the only ones having fun! I want you to enjoy it too, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: C'mon, no stress! Let's just have fun!

choices.text: Even against all five of you, I'd still come out on top.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: I like the confidence! Alright then, I'll give it my all, too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, how could you even think of going against Paimon! We're a team!

talks.objective: Have a spray painting competition with Bennett
Head to the highest point of the "Airborne Asha"
Defeat Bennett in the final showdown of the spray painting competition

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #Haha, that was so much fun! Thanks for a good match, {NICKNAME}! The Asha and I had a great time!

choices.text: I'd say it was pretty even.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Nice work up there, guys!

response.speaker: Tikraq
response.text: #Congratulations for taking home the win, {NICKNAME}. And a big shout out to our magnanimous benefactor and his Asha companion for their amazing teamwork!

response.speaker: Tikraq
response.text: When I heard you interpret what the Asha was saying earlier, I didn't quite believe it. But after this match, I have to say, I'm truly impressed...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Same here! Both of you had me on the edge of my seat the whole time! It felt just like watching the finals of the Pilgrimage!

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Yeah, honestly, the more heated things got out there, the more I wanted to fly up and fire off a few bullets myself.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: What, you got paintballs on you or something?

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Something like that — the final color would be a bit of an unknown, though. And I couldn't guarantee that Asha would stay airborne after I was done with it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhhh...

response.speaker: Tikraq
response.text: Hehe! Well, we're now just one step away from completing the Airborne Asha.

response.speaker: Tikraq
response.text: Our two heroes just need to light up the Airborne Asha's brushes!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: (Play Asha landmark timeline)

response.speaker: Tikraq
response.text: Looks amazing, right? I can recommend a viewpoint that'd be perfect for a group photo!

choices.text: You and the Asha made a brilliant team.
I should have asked for Paimon's help.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so now you remember Paimon? Bit late for that!

talks.objective: Go to the scenic spot recommended by the staff

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Alright! The Airborne Asha's looking great, and everyone's in the frame. Chasca, move a little closer to the middle!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Hehe, a job well done!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Everyone ready?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, you need to get in the picture too!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Yep, yep, just one sec and we're good! Okay, all set!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Three, two, one...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Asha!
